tools.name: show_interface
tools.title: Show an interface
tools.description:
Shows an interactive interface inside the conversation, drawn by the SayShape engine from a spec you write. Use it for every visual or interactive answer (charts, tables, dashboards, stat cards, forms, calculators, trackers) rather than writing HTML, React, SVG or chart code, or making an artifact. Specs can't run code or choose colors. The result lists lines the parser skipped, with the docs for those elements, so you can fix them.

QUICK START
- One element per line: type "text" prop=value prop="quoted value" prop={expression}. Indent children 2 spaces.
- Props stay on their element's line. A line holding only if={…} shows the lines indented under it while true; else after it, otherwise.
- State first, unindented, every value on one line: state count=0 name="Ada" todos=[{text: "Water", done: false}]
- derive name={expr}, unindented, one per line, keeps a value worked out from state: derive total={sum(cart, 'price', 'qty')}, then {total}. Read-only (no bind= or actions); no loops through itself
- Text and props show state: text "Total: {money(total)}"; actions run on press: button "Add" on=inc:count
- Any element takes tip="…": a short explanation shown on hover, focus or a tap: for a term or a number some people won't know, instead of more words on screen.
- on=emit:pick:{x.name} sends a choice to you; no handler blocks. Also update the screen: on=set:sel:{x.name};emit:pick:{x.name}
- Functions (no others exist): min, max, len, count, filter, find, search, sort, first, last, pluck, take, slice, sum, avg, group, join, includes, round, floor, ceil, abs, pow, fixed, money, number, compact, plural, lower, upper, trim. The best row: first(sort(rows, 'revenue', 'desc')).month; a total: sum(rows, 'revenue'); within a budget: filter(rows, 'price', {to: budget})
ELEMENTS
- layout: column, row, overlap, grid, card, list, list-item, accordion, divider, spacer, each, timeline, carousel, scroll
- content: text, image, code, badge, avatar, callout, icon, tile
- data: stat, rating, chart, meter, table, compare, details, schedule, board, tree, flow, map
- input: button, link, check, switch, radio, select, date-picker, stepper, slider, input, segmented, menu
- navigation: screen, tabs, breadcrumb, pagination
- feedback: progress, skeleton, empty, dialog
PICK BY WHAT YOU'RE SHOWING (instead of rebuilding these from simpler parts)
- a headline number with its change and recent trend: stat change="+12%" spark=weekly
- a target or forecast on bars: chart kind=bar holding chart-rule y=50000
- a ranking or a top 10 with long names: chart kind=hbar
- parts of each total: chart kind=stacked y=hardware,software
- an amount over time: chart kind=area
- two or more series over the same time: chart kind=line y=web,mobile
- how one whole splits up: chart kind=donut
- stages people drop out of: chart kind=funnel
- changes adding up to a total: chart kind=waterfall total="Net income"
- several KPIs, quotas or budgets against their targets (good=down when under target is good): chart kind=bullet target=goal
- one number across two dimensions: chart kind=heatmap rows=day x=hour y=orders
- how two numbers relate: chart kind=scatter x=risk y=return label=name
- parts of a total when there are too many for a pie: chart kind=treemap
- how amounts flow from sources to where they end up: chart kind=sankey from=source to=target
- one score against its range: meter kind=gauge bands="60,85"
- many rows with several columns: table items=rows holding table-column field=name
- 2 to 4 options side by side: compare holding compare-row best=low
- one record's fields: details holding detail
- shifts, bookings or a project plan (Gantt) on a calendar: schedule view=week|day|timeline
- a pipeline or task board by stage: board stage=status move=true
- a nested breakdown, or an org chart (kind=org): tree items=rows parent=parent
- a process, journey or decision tree: flow items=steps next=next kind=kind
- places on a map: map holding pin
- a badge over a card: overlap
- steps in order with their status: timeline holding step status=done|current|upcoming
- cards to page through: carousel bind=page
- a long list inside a card: scroll size=md
- the one takeaway or warning to notice first: callout tone=warn
- playing cards, seats, dice or keys: tile "A" icon=spade
- one choice from a long list: select items=teams bind=team
- filtering by several values at once: select items=regions bind=shown multiple=true
- choosing a date, or a period such as the last 30 days (range=true): date-picker bind=due
- a form that says what's missing or wrong: input required=true kind=email
- switching a view between 2 to 6 options: segmented bind=view options="Week,Month,Year"
- several actions on one item without a row of buttons: menu holding menu-item
- how much of one total is done: progress value=read max=pages
- nothing to show yet, or no results: empty "No results"
- checking before something that can't be undone: dialog bind=confirm size=sm
IN A CHAT: under 600px. Title, filters, a few KPIs in grid min=140, one main chart; no nested cards. Caption estimates.
BEFORE YOU USE AN ELEMENT the first time, get its props and an example from sayshape_docs (elements: ["chart", "table"]). Topics: expressions, actions, lists, rules, examples, chat.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.title: List imported MCP result datasets
tools.description: Lists ids, column names and types for tool results ingested by the trusted host. Never returns full rows.

tools.name: fetch_dataset
tools.title: Fetch a dataset's rows
tools.description: Used by the SayShape interface to load a dataset's rows. Not for the model.
